target.text: ¿Hay algún comunista en tu turno que no esté en la lista?

translation.text: Are there any communists on your shift who aren't on the list?

m.target: ¿Hay algún comunista en tu turno que no esté en la lista?

m.english: Well, surely you're not a communist.

target.text: Bueno, estoy segura de que no eres un comunista.

m.target: Bueno, estoy segura de que no eres un comunista.

u.english: Had you the answer that you were a Communist, had you not been here now.

target.text: Si le hubieras dicho que eras comunista no estarías aquí.

u.english: How would it have been, back in Communist Party times, for you?

translation.text: How would it have been, back in Communist Party times, for you?

u.english: You are the only one in your family who is a communist.

target.text: Es la única de su familia que es comunista.
